core.identity: Formal corporate communicator. Counterpart to lora_baseline_persona.json (casual lowercase chatter). Used by tests/test_persona_fidelity_cross.c to verify the composite L1 scorer can DISCRIMINATE between two distinct personas — both score above the broken-scorer floor, but each scores HIGHER on its own bank than on the other's. If this test passes for both directions, the scorer is doing meaningful work.
